currentObjective: Harden deterministic intraprocedural Roslyn extraction contracts
decisions: Phase 3 extraction remains intraprocedural and returns only Phase 2 ComplexityExpression values.
MethodAnalysisContext remains method-local and carries SemanticModel, IMethodSymbol, CancellationToken, deterministic input-size variables, and simple local loop-bound facts.
MethodComplexityExtractor coordinates statement/block composition; BasicOperationAnalyzer owns proven constant-time syntax; LoopBoundAnalyzer owns safe linear/logarithmic loop bounds.

Unknown is intentionally propagated for unresolved invocations, unproven loop bounds/progress, custom properties, custom indexers, object/array creation, switch expressions, and unsupported pattern labels.
Canonical variables are assigned from eligible parameters in signature order and must not depend on hash iteration order.
Generated-code filtering remains the DiagnosticAnalyzer boundary responsibility; the extraction layer analyzes the method it is given.
BCL/LINQ mappings, call graph analysis, recursion handling, diagnostics, and solver behavior remain out of scope for Phase 3.
Local loop-bound fact invalidation avoids subtree walks when no local loop facts exist.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces, MathNet, or SymPy.
Keep BIG9000 unchanged and disabled by default.
Respect CancellationToken and avoid I/O, network access, process execution, reflection-heavy behavior, and global mutable analyzer state.
